name: Watch Fire

components.pose: She sits on a rock beside a low camp fire at night with her weapon across her knees and her wings wrapped around her shoulders, staring into the flames and then toward the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Firelight flickers along her wings while curling green venom mist and falling drops curl in the heat above the fire, {{MAGIC}} light low in her eyes.

notes: QUIET: Watch Fire, for her alignment (rank 9); from data/art/_settings/scene-recipes.json.
